title: Who Defines Fairness? Target-Based Prompting for Demographic Representation in Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Automated post-hoc classification of facial skin tones in generated images using the Fitzpatrick scale (via Individual Typology Angle calculations) and Monk Skin Tone scale, comparing the distributions of skin tones across high, moderate, and low-prestige occupations as well as abstract, socioeconomic, and criminal contexts.

Qualitative visual assessment of perceived gender presentation in model-generated outputs for specific occupations (e.g., librarian, social worker) and non-occupational abstract prompts to identify baseline gender skews.
